reviewMethod: Independent visual reading of all 20 paper pages and all 20 scheme pages; every detailed scale checked against the summary on page 5.
sourceNotes: All ten questions are required. Candidate and offered totals are both 300 marks. Question 9 is 45 marks and Question 10 is 55 marks.
34 independently marked units. Q2(b)(i)–(iv), Q5(a)/(b)/(c) and Q7(b)/(c) retain their complete shared allocations.
2019 bands are 5C=0,1,2,5; 10C=0,3,5,10; 10D=0,3,5,6,10; 15D=0,3,6,9,15. These differ from later Foundation schemes.
Q9(d) full-sized logo construction uses the physical-scale ruler; source includes the original logo on page 14 and construction workspace on page 15.
Q5 parts (a)–(d) explicitly require relevant work on the graph. That instruction is retained in each applicable card.

cards.stem: Aoife has €30. She spends ½ of this money on magazines. Then, she spends €12·50 of what’s left at the cinema.
cards.questionText: How much money has she left after paying for the magazines and the cinema?

cards.stem: Aoife has two brothers, Brian and Calvin. Each of the three has their own money box. The total amount of money in the three boxes is €164. The amounts in Aoife and Brian’s boxes add up to €117.
cards.questionText: How much is in Calvin’s box?

cards.stem: Aoife has two brothers, Brian and Calvin. Each of the three has their own money box. The total amount of money in the three boxes is €164. The amounts in Aoife and Brian’s boxes add up to €117. Aoife has €5 more than Brian.
cards.questionText: How much does Brian have in his box?

cards.stem: A letter is chosen at random from the word ‘S T A T I S T I C S’.

cards.questionText: (i) Complete the table. A student is chosen at random from the group. What is the probability that the student: (ii) is a boy who walks to school; (iii) is a girl; (iv) travels to school by bus?

cards.questionText: How many games did his team lose?

cards.stem: Maia is travelling from Galway to Belfast by bus. The bus leaves Galway at 12:30. It makes two stops on the journey. The first stop is in Athlone (A). cards.questionText: (a) How long did it take the bus to get to Athlone (A), the first stop? (b) At what time did the bus arrive in Monaghan, the second stop? (c) For how long did the bus stop in Monaghan?
